help.headers: Optional. An object of headers: `{ Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token, 'X-Id': id }`.
help.body: Optional. An expression: an object is sent as JSON (`{ name: user.name }`), a string as is, a File as its content.
help.responseAs: How to read the response: auto — by Content-Type, text — as a string, json — parse JSON, file — save as a File.
